<thought>Using the ESI‑MS spectrum, the most intense ion is at m/z 194.0862. Assuming this is the [M+H]⁺ ion, the neutral mass is 194.0862 − 1.0073 ≈ 193.079 Da. The formula C₁₁H₁₃O₃ has a calculated exact mass of 193.0865 Da, giving an [M+H]⁺ of 194.0937 Da, which matches the observed m/z within the experimental tolerance and is the best fit among plausible C/H/O combinations. Therefore the molecular formula is C₁₁H₁₃O₃.</thought>
<final_answer>C11H13O3</final_answer>
